sources.document_title: TMP1075 Temperature Sensor With I2C and SMBus Interface in Industry Standard LM75 Form Factor and Pinout
sources.locator: Title block (TEXAS INSTRUMENTS logo, header 'SBOS854F – MARCH 2018 – REVISED JUNE 2024') and Section 1 Features
sources.evidence_extract: TI datasheet SBOS854F, revision F, revised June 2024, PRODUCTION DATA: TMP1075 temperature sensor with I2C and SMBus interface, LM75 form factor and pinout. 49-page PDF, 2,813,742 bytes as retrieved.

sources.document_title: TMP1075 Temperature Sensor With I2C and SMBus Interface in Industry Standard LM75 Form Factor and Pinout
sources.locator: Section 5 Pin Configuration and Functions: Figure 5-1 D Package 8-Pin SOIC Top View; Table 5-1 Pin Functions, SOIC/VSSOP/WSON pin column
sources.evidence_extract: Table 5-1, SOIC pins: 1 SDA (I/O, serial data, open-drain output that requires a pullup resistor); 2 SCL (I, serial clock); 3 ALERT (O, overtemperature alert, open-drain output that requires a pullup resistor); 4 GND; 5 A2 (I, connect to GND or V+); 6 A1 (I, connect to GND, V+, SDA, or SCL); 7 A0 (I, connect to GND, V+, SDA, or SCL); 8 V+ (supply, 1.7 V to 5.5 V for TMP1075).

sources.document_title: TMP1075 Temperature Sensor With I2C and SMBus Interface in Industry Standard LM75 Form Factor and Pinout
sources.locator: Section 6.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings table; Section 6.2 ESD Ratings table; Section 6.3 Recommended Operating Conditions table
sources.evidence_extract: 6.1: V+ max 6.5 V (TMP1075), 4 V (TMP1075N); SCL, SDA, A1, A0 input -0.3 V to 6.5 V (TMP1075); A2 input -0.3 V to (V+) + 0.3 V (TMP1075); TJ 150 C; Tstg -60 C to 130 C. 6.2: HBM 2000 V, CDM 1000 V. 6.3: supply 1.7 V to 5.5 V (TMP1075), 1.62 V to 3.6 V (TMP1075N); TA -55 C to 125 C (TMP1075).

sources.document_title: TMP1075 Temperature Sensor With I2C and SMBus Interface in Industry Standard LM75 Form Factor and Pinout
sources.locator: Section 6.4 Thermal Information table, column D (SOIC) 8 pins; Section 6.5 Electrical Characteristics: TMP1075 table, rows Accuracy (DGK, D), Resolution, VIH, VIL, VOL
sources.evidence_extract: 6.4 D (SOIC): RthetaJA 130.4 C/W. 6.5 (TA -55 C to 125 C, V+ 1.7 V to 5.5 V; typical at 25 C, 3.3 V): accuracy DGK, D: +/-0.25 typ, +/-1 max (-40 C to 110 C); +/-0.25 typ, +/-2 max (-55 C to 125 C). Resolution 1 LSB (12 bit) 0.0625 C (TYP column). VIH 0.7(V+) min; VIL 0.3(V+) max; VOL 0.4 V max at IOL = -3 mA, SDA and ALERT pins.

sources.document_title: TMP1075 Temperature Sensor With I2C and SMBus Interface in Industry Standard LM75 Form Factor and Pinout
sources.locator: Section 6.5 Electrical Characteristics: TMP1075 table (continued), rows IQ Quiescent current (serial bus inactive) and ISD Shutdown current
sources.evidence_extract: IQ, serial bus inactive: R1=0 R0=0 (default) 10 typ / 20 max uA; R1=0 R0=1 5.5 / 9 uA; R1=1 R0=0 4 / 6 uA; R1=1 R0=1 2.7 / 4 uA; during 5.5 ms active conversion 52 / 85 uA. ISD, serial bus inactive, A0=A1=A2=SCL=SDA=V+, 25 C: 0.37 typ / 0.65 max uA.

sources.document_title: TMP1075 Temperature Sensor With I2C and SMBus Interface in Industry Standard LM75 Form Factor and Pinout
sources.locator: Section 7.3.2.2 Serial Bus Address; Table 7-2 TMP1075 Address Pins State, row A2=0 A1=0 A0=0
sources.evidence_extract: Three address pins allow up to 32 devices. Table 7-2: A2=0, A1=0, A0=0 gives 7-bit address 1001000. Pin states are sampled on every bus communication.

sources.document_title: TMP1075 Temperature Sensor With I2C and SMBus Interface in Industry Standard LM75 Form Factor and Pinout
sources.locator: Section 7.5.1.2 Configuration Register (address = 01h); Figure 7-12 Configuration Register: TMP1075; Configuration Register Field Descriptions table, rows R[1:0] and SD
sources.evidence_extract: Power-up or reset value of the configuration register is 00FFh (TMP1075N: 60A0h). R[1:0] reset 0 (TMP1075): conversion rate in continuous conversion mode, 00 = 27.5 ms. SD reset 0: 0 = device is in continuous conversion, 1 = shutdown mode.

sources.document_title: TMP1075 Temperature Sensor With I2C and SMBus Interface in Industry Standard LM75 Form Factor and Pinout
sources.locator: Section 8.2 Typical Application, Figure 8-1 Typical Connections; Section 8.2.1 Design Requirements; Section 8.2.2 Detailed Design Procedure
sources.evidence_extract: Figure 8-1: supply bypass capacitor 0.01 uF, pullup resistors 5k. 8.2.1: the recommended pullup value is 5 kOhm; pullup current is recommended not to exceed 3 mA on SCL and SDA; A2 connects only to GND or V+; an unused ALERT pin can be connected to GND or left floating. 8.2.2: place the device close to the monitored heat source with good thermal coupling; isolate package and leads from ambient air for air or surface measurement.

sources.document_title: TMP1075 Temperature Sensor With I2C and SMBus Interface in Industry Standard LM75 Form Factor and Pinout
sources.locator: Section 8.3 Power Supply Recommendations; Section 8.4.1 Layout Guidelines; Figure 8-2 Layout Example (D Package)
sources.evidence_extract: 8.3: D, DGK, DSG packages operate from 1.7 V to 5.5 V; a power-supply bypass capacitor is required for precision and stability, placed as close to the supply and ground pins as possible; typical value 0.01 uF. To minimize self-heating TI recommends the minimum supply rail, no I2C traffic during conversion, one-shot mode, pullups < 10 kOhm. 8.4.1: the recommended bypass value is 0.01 uF; pull up SDA and ALERT through 5 kOhm resistors; SCL needs a pullup only if the host output is open drain.
